dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin started as a meme.  The traders who bought it on Robinhood and are better off today than if they held USD.  Now it may be used for payments.  

All memes aren’t bad – gotta weed out the ones that are and organize the launches/markets better.  

Memes won’t be our focus.

@brave_raf I feel the same for the majority, and I would never build a business around it – but $DOGE always gives me pause.  Started as a meme but Elon made a case that there would he a good reason for that to be the money used on Mars!  So I wonder if you had a more organized market,

My test is:  “Are there lots of people that wanna trade it?”

Yes?  Create a fair and organized market around it, and don’t overthink it.

I’ve traded the most “respected” assets in my TradFi days – but being part of the $DOGE launch on RH was way more fulfilling.

The L1 founder I look up to the most?   

Every city I travel to I always run into this one founder “pounding the pavement”.  He gets around more than any of us. 

Gotta give credit where credit is due.  $DOGE https://t.co/SzsqvaN5Bm
